connector.name: Mpp32 MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Payment layer for AI agents. One MCP, five protocols, thousands of paid APIs your agent can call.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mpp32-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mpp32 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: MPP32_AGENT_KEY
env.description: Session key from https://mpp32.org/agent-console. Unlocks the full federated catalog and attributes every call to your dashboard. Optional in legacy mode where only native services are reachable.

env.name: MPP32_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Solana private key used to sign x402 USDC payments locally. Only needed when calling paid services that prefer x402. Stays on your machine, never sent to MPP32 servers.

env.name: MPP32_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Ethereum L2 private key used to sign Tempo pathUSD payments locally. Optional fallback for paid services when x402 is not available. Stays on your machine, never sent to MPP32 servers.

env.name: MPP32_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL for custom deployments. Defaults to https://mpp32.org.
